name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. Domain=spell. The '8' is a meaningful spell ID (valid spell IDs are 00h-23h), NOT a Ghidra address residue. Descriptor 'via_targeted_blink' correctly reflects delegation to fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell (the targeted blink-overlay worker). Consistent with the four sibling handlers id 0/1/2/3 that share the identical naming pattern.
purpose: Spell dispatch thunk for spell_id=8: forwards the cast to the targeted blink-overlay offensive worker with spell_id literal 8.
logic_summary: Thin wrapper registered as entry index 8 of the spell dispatch table @ 0x51D01 (slot @ 0x51D21). Calls fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell(caster, 8, n_tgt, tgt_arr). In the binary the body is a multi-entry/shared-tail thunk: PUSH 0x14; CALL __CHK (stack probe); push args; PUSH 0x8 (spell_id); JMP 0x2121A which lands in the id-0 sibling's tail (PUSH caster + CALL worker @ 0x21227 + ADD ESP,0x10 + RET). The __CHK probe and shared tail are compiler-emitted artifacts; the source expresses an equivalent self-contained wrapper.
